run_validate_reports: run the validate_reports function to compare generated benchmark reports against baseline reports
run_validate_report_cli: run the validate_report CLI module with --input-artifacts-dir and --input-report-dir flags
validate_reports_with_deviation: validate benchmark reports by comparing metrics within an acceptable deviation threshold
review_validate_reports: review the validate_reports function that reads baseline CSV reports and compares them to generated reports
refactor_validate_reports: refactor the validate_reports function to support additional metric validation or reporting formats
